# Boozuka

> Boozuka is a tech, design and AI studio based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India. One in-house team builds websites, web apps and custom software, designs brands and interfaces (UI/UX, logo and branding, creatives), sets up AI agents, chatbots and automation, and runs SEO, social media, ads and video for businesses in Punjab and across India. Boozuka was founded by Jashanpreet Singh, with co-founder Megha Walia.

## Services (four pillars)
1. Build: websites, web apps, custom software and CRMs
2. Design: UI/UX, logo and branding, social creatives, packaging and print
3. Automate: AI agents, WhatsApp and website chatbots, workflow automation
4. Grow: Google SEO and Google Business Profile, social media, Meta and Google ads, video editing

## Industries
Shops and showrooms; salons and spas; cafes and restaurants; clinics; gyms; service businesses; coaching and training institutes.

Bundle offer: 10% off two monthly services for 3 months. Final fixed quote after a free 30-minute audit.

## Frequently asked questions

**What is Boozuka?**
Boozuka is an AI automation and digital marketing agency based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India. It is a digital growth partner for any business that wants to go online and grow, from shops, salons, cafes and clinics to service businesses and training institutes. It builds websites, runs Google SEO, Maps and ads, and sets up AI automation such as WhatsApp chatbots and simple CRMs, all delivered by an in-house team. Boozuka was founded by Jashanpreet Singh, with co-founder Megha Walia.

**Who founded Boozuka?**
Boozuka was founded by Jashanpreet Singh, who leads strategy and client relationships. Megha Walia is co-founder; she also owns Chahat Industries and leads business strategy and client relationships at Boozuka.

**Where is Boozuka based?**
Boozuka is based in Ludhiana, Punjab, India, and works with businesses across Punjab and India, in person and online.

**What services does Boozuka offer?**
AI automation (WhatsApp chatbots, website chatbots, lead capture to CRM and follow-up reminders), website development, Google SEO and Google Business Profile optimisation, Meta and Google ads, CRM and custom software, and video editing.

**Which businesses does Boozuka work with?**
Any business that wants to grow online: shops and showrooms, salons and spas, cafes and restaurants, clinics, gyms, service businesses, and coaching or training institutes.

**How do I get a quote from Boozuka?**
Fill the 1-minute growth plan form at boozuka.com/get-quote or message +91 82890 94569 on WhatsApp. Starting prices are listed on the pricing page.
